messages:
marie: Heads up — seeing a spike in fncall strict_validation rejects that are routing to fallback/degen and blowing up quotas for a handful of customers. Console shows a bunch of 'validation_reason=missing_object' on fnhook payloads.

dave: Can you paste a sample payload?

marie: Sample from request logs: ```{ "model": "gpt-4-open", "fncall": { "name": "get_user_profile", "args": "{\"user_id\":123}", "hook_args": null }, "route_id": "mvp-primary" }```

samir: Null hook_args should be allowed (nullable union). Validator is flagging it as missing required object -> strict reject. Odd that it rerouted to fallback-degen — was the reject classified as a hard reject?

lee: Telemetry shows the ingest pipeline recorded validation_reason=missing_object but billing tag got set to 'degraded'. It looks like somewhere upstream null -> [] coercion happened, so validator saw an array where it expected object/null.

marie: I suspect the edge JSON sanitizer from PR 1234. It coerces nulls for arrays to [] in some code paths. @deploy-bot any recent sanitizer rollouts?

deploy-bot: deploy: edge-sanitizer v2.3 deployed to prod at 2023-12-03T14:05:12Z (tag v2.3.1)

dave: If sanitizer changed types we get two issues: (1) malformed payloads -> rejects, (2) telemetry/billing counts them as strict rejects and attributes to primary route. Need to ensure telemetry maps validation_reason before sanitizer or keep original raw payload for validation.

samir: Short-term workaround: add a permissive mapping in validator to treat empty-array as null for hook_args so we don't reject. Long-term we should preserve null semantics in sanitizer.

lee: Workaround hides a bug. Two options: revert sanitizer (fast) or patch validator (safer but slower). Which is faster to mitigate customer impact?

marie: I have a revert ready for the proxy config. Suggest revert now, then patch sanitizer to preserve nulls and add tests. I'll also flag affected customers and waive charges.

deploy-bot: Rollback available. To rollback edge-sanitizer v2.3, run: `./ops rollback edge-sanitizer v2.2 --from v2.3 --region=global`

dave: Also the console dashboard didn't show validation tag on the degen traffic metric — missing mapping in telemetry_kv -> route_tag. I'll open ENG-8762 to add mapping and backfill the last 2h.

marie: Filed ENG-8762 (telemetry mapping + backfill).

samir: Can we also make the validator tolerate both array and null for hook_args (union coercion) as a temporary safety net? Add unit/integration test.

lee: OK to add tolerance but please don't ship that as the only fix. Revert + sanitizer patch is preferred.

marie: Rolling back now, will update in 5m. Also DM'ing billing with affected list to waive charges.

billing: Thanks — please DM the list when you have it and we'll hold charges.

[~5m later]

marie: Rollback complete. Strict_rejects back to baseline, routing corrected, quotas unstuck. Console metrics reflect primary route again. Will follow up with a short postmortem and tests.

samir: Please add an urgent test in the telemetry ingest suite to ensure sanitizer doesn't mutate types (null vs empty array).

lee: Agree. Also add an alert if validation_reason mapping is missing for any route-tag in the next deploy.

marie: Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
